title: Hardware-efficient variational quantum eigensolver for small molecules and quantum magnets
problem_summary: Introduces the hardware-efficient ansatz for VQE, computing LiH and BeH2 ground-state energies on a 6-qubit superconducting processor and separately an energy-minimization procedure on a 4-qubit Heisenberg model.

components.family_or_name: LiH and BeH2 ground-state energies; 4-qubit Heisenberg model
components.notes: Two distinct problem classes: molecular chemistry and a condensed-matter spin model.
Ansatz built from the device's native gate set rather than a UCC-derived circuit -- the paper's key methodological contribution.

workflow_composition_notes: Hardware-efficient ansatz parameters optimized in a VQE loop; same ansatz family reused across both the molecular and spin-model problem instances.
